title: Homework after Lesson 8
note: Homework = everything we didn't finish in class. The lists under the first two tasks update themselves as you finish exercises.

items.text: Lesson 8: finish every exercise we didn't get to in class — the reading (Exercise 6) is the main one.
Lesson 7: finish the exercises that are still open.
Learn the 32 verbs from the verb bank — they're in the dictionary. In the quiz, a word drops out after you get it right three times.
Take the quizzes in the Grammar section: Phrasal verbs, and Verb + preposition.

title: Homework after Lesson 7
note: Homework = everything we didn't finish in class. The list under the first task updates itself: when an exercise is done on the lesson page, it disappears.

items.text: Lesson 7: finish every exercise we didn't get to in class — including the writing in Exercise 11.
Take the quizzes in the Grammar section: as … as · not as … as, and whereas · although · despite.
Learn the 16 football words from the GOAT text and the 2 words you saved yourself — obviously and cracked (they're in the dictionary).
Extra: Exercise 13 — write 'My GOAT', 80–100 words.

title: Homework after Lesson 6
note: Homework = everything we didn't finish in class. The lists under each task update themselves: when an exercise is done on the lesson page, it disappears from the list.

items.text: Lesson 6: finish every exercise we didn't get to in class.
Lesson 5: finish the exercises that are still open — the main one is Exercise 6 (Present Perfect or Past Simple).
Lesson 4: type your story (Exercise 14) and do Exercises 15–16.
Take the quizzes in the Grammar section: All five tenses, Comparatives and superlatives, Present Perfect vs Past Simple. Your score is saved — I can see it.
Learn the 16 comparing words from Lesson 6 and the 7 words you saved yourself (they're now in the dictionary).

title: Homework after Lesson 5
note: Two things are the main ones: the bucket-list text and the unfinished work from Lesson 4. Type everything on the lesson pages — that is how I see it.

items.text: Exercise 10: write your bucket list, 70–95 words — three things you've done (with one Past Simple detail each) and two you haven't done yet.
Carry-over from Lesson 4: type your Exercise 14 story into the box on the Lesson 4 page and finish Exercises 15 and 16 there.
Learn the 16 words from Lesson 5 and the third forms from the Grammar tab — five verbs a day.
Finish the extra Exercises 11 and 12 on the Lesson 5 page (find the mistake, just / already / yet).
Take the quizzes in the Grammar section: Present Perfect: experiences, and Present Perfect vs Past Simple.
Optional: do the exercises on the British Council page for the Skateboarding heroes video.

title: Homework after Lesson 4
note: The writing task is the main one. Do the irregular verbs in small groups of three, not all at once.

items.text: Exercise 14: write 90–120 words about a day that went wrong. Real or invented.
Learn the 24 words from Lesson 4 — strong adjectives, narrative verbs and linkers.
Learn the irregular verbs from the Grammar tab. Three a day is enough.
Finish Exercises 15 and 16 on the lesson page (all four tenses, find the mistake).
Take the quizzes in the Grammar section: Past Simple, Past Continuous, while / when.
Optional: do the two exercises on the British Council page for the Sherlock Holmes video.

title: Homework after Lesson 3
note: Two short paragraphs are the main thing here — one in each tense. Everything else is quick.

items.text: Learn the 20 routine words from the Lesson 3 vocabulary — run them through the trainer twice.
Exercise 11: write 80–100 words in two paragraphs — your normal day in the Present Simple, and today in the Present Continuous.
Finish Exercises 12–14 on the lesson page (plans, how long does it take, find the mistake).
Take the quiz in the Grammar section: Present Simple vs Present Continuous (the link is next to Exercise 5 on the lesson page).
Optional: do the exercises on the British Council page for the Roman Britain video.

title: Homework after Lesson 2
note: Do it in parts, not all at once. If something is unclear, tell me and we'll go through it in the lesson.

items.text: Learn 10 new words from the Lesson 2 vocabulary — run them through the trainer twice.
Write 6 sentences about your hobby: 2 in the Present Simple, 2 in the Present Continuous, 2 in the Past Simple.
Take the quizzes in the Grammar section: Past Simple and Past Continuous.
Watch one 6 Minute English episode and write down 5 new words.
Prepare a one-minute talk: How I started my hobby.

title: Homework after Lesson 1
note: The first set of words from the reading text.

items.text: Learn the 9 words from Lesson 1 in the vocabulary section.
Write 5 sentences using the new words.
